cookSays.line: 📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Everett Bhatt. Roofer. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Seed packet, Boot stone, Carpenter's square, Mixtape, Dog tags. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong. They move when you aren't looking. Yesterday there were seven. Tonight there are nine. They're getting closer.
A woman, maybe 30s, with freckles is feeding the fire one stick at a time, watching the flame take. Better close to the fire today.
A woman, maybe 60s is mending something by the door — patient work. Better close to the fire today.
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.
A woman, maybe 30s, with freckles is feeding the fire one stick at a time, watching the flame take. Better close to the fire today.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with freckles about A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s telling A person, maybe 30s, with thick glasses about themself. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Elif and Valeria lingered over the fire together.
Recipe: Hunting spear (Level 1). You have seen a hunting spear. Longer than a man, stone at the killing end.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 40s: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"

A person, maybe 30s, with weathered hands has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Nadia passes around white umbrella flowers over hollow purple-streaked stems in the marsh. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

Khalil spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.

👀 You caught the person in their 30s, with weathered hands, the pottery instructor rehearsing — muttering details about Denver under their breath before the evening fire, like someone cramming for a part.
🔥 Devon says it at the fire, not quite looking at Vanessa: “Your trade story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.

“You’re right.” Vanessa doesn’t look up. “I wasn’t pottery instructor. I was night security guard. I’m sorry — I wanted a cleaner story than I had.” The fire lets it land. Someone passes Vanessa the bowl without a word.
"Dorothy," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Dorothy." You'll remember that.
